stories: EQ-159 #493 (microprice and selected quote dynamics), EQ-160 #494 (VWAP slopes and selected path statistics); consumed by EF4 I/O and worker tasks and release acceptance EQ-163; siblings EQ-158 #492 and EQ-172 and the tape and path-efficiency contracts are by other authors
evidence_kind: documentation and hand-derived expected values: each headline value is written by hand in the fixture definition as an exact fraction; an independent stdlib harness (ef4h_fixture_expand.py, outside the repository) recomputes every fixture from its inputs with exact fractions and compares status, reasons, counts, values, float.hex and witnesses; nothing was executed against the library
frozen_contract_ref: docs/ef1/CONTRACT.json ef1-contract1, the accepted R17 intraday foundations, docs/features/QUOTE_FORMULAS.md, EF1_PATHS.md, EF1_ANCHORS.md and the merged EF3 contracts are read-only and unchanged; this packet is additive

parameters: sampling (trade_snapshot|continuous; must equal the quotes batch sampling)

policy.interval: declared half-open [S, E) from one ef4.interval.bounds fact; E <= market cutoff C else future_market; no seed and no pre-open state
policy.classification: invalid (null or nonpositive side), normal (a > b), locked (a = b), crossed (a < b); valid = normal or locked; crossed and invalid are counted by the existing session.quote.state_counts and excluded here
policy.microprice: (b*Qa + a*Qb)/(Qa + Qb), both sizes positive; zero size is size-ineligible, null size on a consumed valid observation is null_field
policy.last: the final admitted observation only; never carried back through an invalid, crossed or size-ineligible final state
policy.change: first and last valid observation; adjacent pairs in the admitted total order; continuous sampling only
policy.maxima: largest per-observation cash spread and largest per-observation own-midpoint bps over all admitted valid observations; ties earliest (event_ns, order_key, event_id)
policy.no_policy: no staleness limit, no default window, no seed, no size weighting across observations, no time weighting

parameters: grid_version (string equal to the grid role text; present exactly when series_source is bar or prepared_window)
series_policy_id (opaque non-empty label equal to the proof fact text; present exactly when series_source is prepared_window)

policy.path: anchored cumulative VWAP W_k = sum(N_i)/sum(V_i) over the first k path points, reset at the declared anchor (interval start), no carry across intervals
policy.operand: trade: eligible price*size at event time; bar and prepared_window: supplied actual notional over volume at the completed bar end; close*volume or typical price is never used
policy.time_axis: UTC nanosecond wall-clock; slopes published per second (exact factor 10^9); no resampling, no index axis, no volume axis
policy.zero_volume: a covered zero-volume window contributes no point and no weight
policy.slopes: endpoint (W_n - W_1)/(x_n - x_1) and ordinary least squares of W_k on x_k with equal point weights
policy.prepared: a supplied compatible window series is accepted without recomputation when its proof fact, grid, anchor, unit and basis bind; trades are never read
policy.no_policy: no default source, no default window grid, no minimum points, no thresholds

continuous sampling; interval ready; counts the adjacent valid pairs whose midpoints differ (0 is a value)
continuous sampling; interval ready; counts adjacent valid-valid pairs in the admitted total order (0 is a value)
interval ready; the final admitted observation is valid with both sizes positive
interval ready; every valid observation has both sizes present; at least one valid observation has both sizes positive
interval ready; at least one valid observation; sizes are not read
interval ready; at least one valid observation; sizes are not read
path ready with at least two points
path ready with at least one point
path ready with at least one point
path ready with at least one point
anchor, proof and every slot's volume or size ready (prices and notionals are not read); 0 is a value
path ready with at least two points and a positive time span
path ready with at least two points and a positive time variance

header_order: lexicographic by feature_id within a producer; each output has its own required operands, expected and observed counts and independent readiness

quote_dynamics.contract: exactly one ef4.interval.bounds fact: effective_start_ns = S, effective_end_ns = E, S < E; required by every output

full normalized bid/ask state or snapshot per admitted row (never a delta); bid, ask int64 coefficients at the price scale (null or nonpositive is an invalid state); bid_size, ask_size int64 shares >= 0 or null; event_ns in [S, E) and < C; ordered by (event_ns, order_key); batch metadata sampling trade_snapshot or continuous; None is an absent delivery; the declared IntervalCoverage (complete or incomplete) travels with the batch

vwap_path.contract: exactly one ef4.interval.bounds fact; effective_start_ns = the anchor S, effective_end_ns = E; required by every output
B+1 ef4.window.edge facts for series_source bar or prepared_window: absolute ns, strictly increasing, first = S, last = E, text = grid_version; absent for trade

series_source trade only: eligible flag, price and size int64 (positive when eligible), event_ns in [S, E) and < C, ordered by (event_ns, order_key); ineligible rows are not operands; declared IntervalCoverage travels with the batch

series_source bar or prepared_window: one BAR row per grid slot (start/end equal the slot edges), volume int64 shares >= 0, actual_notional (decimal128 coefficient) required and positive for positive volume, zero-volume rows have null OHLC; a slot may instead be declared incomplete (governed_gap)
series_source prepared_window only: exactly one ef4.series.proof fact binding the supplied window series; absent for trade and bar

ef4.interval.bounds.effective_start_ns: S, the interval start and the VWAP anchor (utc_ns)
ef4.interval.bounds.effective_end_ns: E, the exclusive interval end (utc_ns), > start
ef4.interval.bounds.known_at_ns: original knowledge of the interval and anchor, nullable

ef4.series.proof.text: equals config series_policy_id (opaque, non-empty; names the supplied series preparation and its eligibility policy)
ef4.series.proof.known_at_ns: original knowledge of the series, nullable

reference_fact_schemas.note: require_compatible_inputs applies among market roles (quotes, trades, bars); REFERENCE roles with price_unit None are not compared. Rows inside one (instrument, session) group are ordered by (effective_start_ns, reference_id). price, factor_num and factor_den are null for every EF4-H fact, so no price unit is needed on a REFERENCE batch. The proof fact does not carry the series values: it binds identity, and unit, basis, grid and anchor are checked against the bars batch and the other facts.

mathematics.value_basis: Prices are int64 coefficients at ConfigSpec.price_unit.scale (0..18), one currency and one adjustment basis; sizes and volumes are int64 shares >= 0; every sum, product, midpoint, ratio and regression sum is an exact wide integer or Fraction; the coefficient is divided by 10^scale only at publication; no float enters a comparison or a sort; only published values are float64
mathematics.quote_classification: b, a coefficients; invalid if either is null or <= 0; else d = a - b: normal d > 0, locked d = 0, crossed d < 0; valid = normal or locked
mathematics.quote_values: s = a - b (published s/10^scale); m = (a + b)/2 exactly; z = 10000*s/m = 20000*(a - b)/(a + b) (bps, the observation's own midpoint); mp = (b*Qa + a*Qb)/(Qa + Qb) when Qa > 0 and Qb > 0 (published mp/10^scale); offset = 10000*(mp - m)/m
mathematics.quote_population: V = valid observations; Z = valid observations with both sizes positive; F, L = first and last element of V in the admitted total order; fin = the final admitted observation
mathematics.quote_outputs: maximum_spread = max s over V; maximum_midpoint_bps = max z over V; microprice.last = mp(fin) if fin in Z; last_offset_bps = offset(fin) if fin in Z; microprice.mean = (sum mp over Z)/|Z|; change.midpoint_bps = 10000*(m_L - m_F)/m_F; change.spread = s_L - s_F; pair_count = #{i : obs_i and obs_{i+1} adjacent in the admitted order and both valid}; midpoint_change_count = #{those pairs with m_i != m_{i+1}}
mathematics.quote_witness_selection: maxima: the observation attaining the maximum, earliest by (event_ns, order_key, event_id); evaluated over all admitted valid observations whatever the evidence limit
mathematics.vwap_points: trade source: each eligible trade is a point (x, N, V) = (event_ns, p*q, q); bar and prepared_window: each positive-volume window is a point (end_ns, actual_notional, volume); zero-volume windows and ineligible trades are not points; points ordered by (x, order_key or slot)
mathematics.vwap_outputs: last = W_n; maximum = max W_k; minimum = min W_k; point_count = n; change_bps = 10000*(W_n - W_1)/W_1; endpoint slope = (W_n - W_1)*10^9/(x_n - x_1) per second, needs x_n > x_1; ols slope = 10^9 * (n*sum(x*W) - sum(x)*sum(W))/(n*sum(x^2) - sum(x)^2), needs n >= 2 and a positive denominator
mathematics.publication: exact rational then one correctly rounded (half-even) float64; counts exact int64
mathematics.vwap_witnesses: the cumulative sums read every earlier point, so a single selecting point is not a sufficient witness: path outputs list all points in canonical order, maximum and minimum list the points from the first through the earliest selecting point

quality.rule: all applicable reasons retained in lexical order; status follows the first applicable reason in precedence; a value is null exactly when the status is not available; available implies observed == expected

counts.quote: expected = admitted delivered rows n; observed = rows ready for the output (known_at present and <= K; for microprice outputs a valid consumed row has both sizes present); an unready interval bounds fact gives observed 0; absent batch is 0/0; value-level reasons (no_eligible_observations) keep expected = observed = n; insufficient_history reports expected 2, observed = the valid count
counts.vwap_trade: expected = eligible trades; observed = ready eligible trades (known, size present, price present for price-bearing outputs); an unready anchor gives observed 0
counts.vwap_bar: expected = grid slots B; observed = ready slots (row present or zero-volume row, known, volume present, notional present for price-bearing outputs); gap and absent slots are unready; an unready anchor or proof gives observed 0
counts.zero_denominator: expected = observed = the slot or trade count

evidence.limit: config evidence_limit 0..10000; witnesses never exceed it; unavailable outputs emit none; a limit changes only the witness list length, never a value, status, count or the primary witness
evidence.order: quote maxima: the selecting observation; microprice.last and offset: the final observation; quote change.midpoint_bps and change.spread: first then last valid observation; microprice.mean and point_count: all contributing rows in canonical order; pair counts: rows belonging to at least one counted pair in canonical order, each once. VWAP path outputs read the cumulative sums of every earlier point, so their witnesses are all contributing points in canonical order: last, change_bps, endpoint slope, OLS slope and point_count list every point, maximum and minimum list the points from the first through the earliest selecting point. The interval bounds, anchor and proof facts are bound to the result but consume no witness budget
evidence.row_ids: quote:<event_id>, trade:<event_id>, bar:<start_ns>:<end_ns>; boundary completed_interval for bars; canonical order (event_ns, order_key, event_id)

mode_rule: known_at and reconstruction availability give identical results with original known_at; batch and full replay only; update, restore and merge unsupported

acceptance_rules.exact_float64: reference is a dyadic rational with numerator < 2^53: every exact-rational or Decimal120 path produces it without rounding, so the published float64 must equal the hex bit for bit
acceptance_rules.exact_plus_zero: reference exactly 0 from exact integer arithmetic (equal integers subtract to zero): bit-exact +0.0, never -0.0
acceptance_rules.tolerance: abs(y - r) <= max(8*ulp(r), 1e-12*abs(r)) with r the fixture float64 (the R17 numeric error contract, docs/api/INTRADAY.md, Numeric error contract and capabilities)
acceptance_rules.exact_integer: int64 outputs (pair_count, midpoint_change_count, point_count) are exact

fixture_notation: compact, NOT canonical wire. Quote fixtures: scale price_scale; interval [S,E) = interval.start_ns/end_ns in illustrative integer ns; C = market_cutoff_ns; K = knowledge_cutoff_ns = 100; row = event_id, event_ns, order_key, bid, ask, bid_size, ask_size, known_at (default 50; null = unknown; 150 = future); bounds_known_at is the interval bounds fact knowledge (default 50); quotes.coverage: complete (default), incomplete (declared incomplete delivery, governed_gap) or absent (no declaration); quotes null = the role is not delivered; params.outputs selects the evaluated outputs. VWAP fixtures: times are exact integer nanoseconds (illustrative seconds times 10^9); trade row = event_id, event_ns, order_key, eligible, price, size, known_at; trades.coverage as for quotes; grid_edges_ns lists B+1 absolute edges; bars.slots[i] is slot i (start = edge i, end = edge i+1): state row with volume, notional (null allowed), known_at, optional informational close that must be ignored; state gap = no row and a declared incomplete coverage for the slot; state absent = no row and no coverage; proof is {present, known_at} for prepared_window; edge_known_at lists the known_at of each grid edge fact (default 50); anchor_known_at is the bounds fact knowledge. Placeholders $GRID_VERSION and $SERIES_POLICY stand for caller strings that the expansion binds to the grid text and the proof text. Entity, instrument, session, role and grid ids never appear in a fixture body: the expansion supplies them. Expected entries give status, reasons, expected, observed and for available outputs the exact fraction, float64, float.hex, the per-output acceptance rule and witnesses. Blocked outputs have value null and no witnesses. same_values_as names a fixture whose values (witnesses excepted for truncation fixtures) are identical (or a subset). Refusal fixtures carry a base fixture and a concrete construction recipe. Fixture id V27 (eligible trade with a null price) was withdrawn because the shared validator refuses it, and is not reused. A slot with state row and volume 0 is a zero-volume row; its known_at and notional are not read.

refusal_precedence.rule: a call is refused by the first applicable tier; within the shared validator tier the first offending row of the first offending batch in role order raises; within the library tier the order below applies; assessment (status, reasons) happens only when nothing is refused
tiers: T1 config: C.version (INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION), C.feature (UNKNOWN_FEATURE), C.capability (UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY), C.params (INVALID_CONFIG)
T2 shared batch construction: K.cell_type (INVALID_SCHEMA), K.overflow (OVERFLOW), K.no_unit (INVALID_UNIT), K.no_sampling (UNSUPPORTED_SAMPLING)

T3 shared validate_batch per batch in role order (bounds, grid, proof, quotes/trades/bars): duplicate identity or tie key (DUPLICATE) before ordering (INVALID_ORDER) before interval, cutoff and bounds (BOUNDS) before schema rules (INVALID_SCHEMA), negative quantity last (BOUNDS)

T4 library: L.batch_kind, L.fact_kind (INVALID_SCHEMA); L.scale (INVALID_UNIT); L.basis (UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT); L.sampling_mismatch, L.change_on_snapshot (UNSUPPORTED_SAMPLING); L.bounds_count, L.bounds_text, L.row_identity, L.source_roles, L.proof_count, L.proof_text, L.grid_text, L.bar_align (INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY); L.row_before_start, L.row_at_or_after_end, L.grid_first_edge, L.grid_last_edge, L.grid_equal_edges, L.bar_end_after_cutoff (BOUNDS); L.bar_notional_positive (INVALID_SCHEMA)
refusal_precedence.dependencies: L.sampling_mismatch is evaluated only when the config sampling is valid; L.grid_text and L.proof_text only when the config value is valid; L.bar_align only on a sound grid (strictly increasing, first edge = S, last edge = E, correct kind and text). Each refusal fixture is a single-fault construction: its recipe fires exactly the one named rule, which the harness verifies by applying the recipe to the base fixture.

shared validator (validation.py validate: trade: duplicate event_id or (event_ns, order_key) DUPLICATE, unordered INVALID_ORDER, event at or after the market cutoff BOUNDS, an eligible trade with null or nonpositive price or size INVALID_SCHEMA
quote: the same identity, order and cutoff rules; a null or nonpositive side is a counted invalid state, never a refusal; negative size BOUNDS

bar: start >= end BOUNDS, duplicate (start, end) DUPLICATE, overlap INVALID_ORDER, end after the market cutoff BOUNDS; volume 0 requires null OHLC and zero or absent notional else INVALID_SCHEMA; volume > 0 with OHLC columns requires positive nonnull coherent OHLC and a notional within [low*volume, high*volume] else INVALID_SCHEMA; negative quantity BOUNDS
reference: duplicate reference identity DUPLICATE, unordered (start, reference_id) INVALID_ORDER, start >= end BOUNDS
library (this contract): interval membership of rows (before S, at or after E) BOUNDS; bar source E > C BOUNDS
positive notional on positive volume when no OHLC columns are delivered (INVALID_SCHEMA)
all identity, grid, proof, role, sampling, unit, basis and config checks

refusal_model: harness model built from a base fixture: config{params,outputs,capability,price_scale,basis}, C, bounds[], grid[], proof[] (facts: instrument, session, reference_id, kind, start, end, text, known_at), quotes|trades|bars {kind, sampling, scale, basis, unit, rows[]} with placeholder instrument I, session S0, snapshot 'snap', reference ids x1:B(i1), x1:B(G#n), x1:B(s1), grid text G and series policy P. Mutation ops: set, del_key, insert, delete, dup, swap on dotted paths (list indices are integers). Placeholders never appear as contract values.

decisions_proposed.decision: Two new producers, ef4.quote_dynamics (EQ-159) and ef4.vwap_path (EQ-160), with separate version and config identities; the existing session.quote.* outputs (sampled means, state counts, time-weighted spread) are unchanged and not reused.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: extend session.quote.* ids; one combined producer. Reason: a changed equation needs a distinct identity (QUOTE_FORMULAS), and the two stories have different roles and readiness.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Config sampling is trade_snapshot (snapshot-weighted) or continuous (update-weighted) and must equal the quotes batch sampling; it is part of the result identity. Trade-snapshot quotes never satisfy a continuous requirement and a continuous batch is never relabelled snapshot-weighted: a mismatch is the existing UNSUPPORTED_SAMPLING refusal, not a missing input. The two populations are never pooled.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: accept and relabel; pool by caller flag. Reason: QUOTE_FORMULAS forbids pooling without a new specification; a structural mismatch is a caller error.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: The target is one declared half-open interval [S, E) from an ef4.interval.bounds fact. Rows outside [S, E) or at/after the market cutoff C are BOUNDS refusals. E > C is incomplete_coverage/future_market. No seed, pre-open or carried state exists in this producer.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: [open, C) implicit; closed end; accepted pre-open seed. Reason: the issue requires an explicitly declared interval; the outputs are sampled-observation statistics and need no initial state.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Classification as in QUOTE_FORMULAS: null or nonpositive side is invalid (a counted state, not a refusal), a = b locked, a < b crossed. Locked is valid and contributes spread 0 and bps 0. Crossed and invalid observations are excluded from every value; a crossed quote never becomes valid by absolute value; they still count as ready observations and break pair adjacency.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: abs(a - b); drop crossed rows before ordering; refuse nonpositive prices. Reason: absolute value hides a crossed book; dropping rows would hide adjacency; nonpositive prices are representable market states.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Sizes are read only by the three microprice outputs. A valid observation with both sizes positive is size-eligible. A zero size on either side makes it size-ineligible (counted, excluded from the microprice population, never a one-sided degenerate price). A null size on a valid observation that the output consumes is null_field (all valid observations for the mean, the final observation for last and offset). Maxima, change and pair counts never read sizes.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: treat zero size as a price rule; treat null size as zero; one global size requirement. Reason: zero displayed size is not independently a price-validity rule (QUOTE_FORMULAS); sizes are independently declared per output (EQ-159 clarification); null is unknown, not zero.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: mp = (b*Qa + a*Qb)/(Qa + Qb): the midpoint tilted toward the side with the smaller displayed size. Sizes are int64 shares as supplied (no round-lot scaling); only their ratio matters and both sides must share one size unit. Price outputs are published as coefficient/10^scale in currency/share; bps outputs are unitless basis points from exact rationals; arithmetic is exact wide integers, so int64-limit inputs never OVERFLOW.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: size-weighted average of quote prices; imbalance index; float arithmetic. Reason: the standard published definition; exactness is the R17 policy.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: microprice.last and its offset use the final admitted observation only. If it is invalid, crossed or size-ineligible the output is not_applicable/no_eligible_observations; an earlier valid quote is never carried through it. A not-yet-known row anywhere in the interval blocks the output (see DP-Q11), because the final observation is unknowable.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: last valid sized observation (carry-back). Reason: invalid and crossed updates replace the previous state immediately (QUOTE_FORMULAS).
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Equal-observation mean over size-eligible valid observations: update-weighted under continuous sampling, snapshot-weighted under trade_snapshot; not size-weighted across observations and not time-weighted. A continuous-time mean is not inferred from sampled observations.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: size-weighted across observations; duration-weighted. Reason: duration weighting needs initial state and expiry (the existing time_weighted_spread); the two modes must stay distinct.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: change.midpoint_bps and change.spread compare the first and last valid observations in the interval (needing two); pair_count and midpoint_change_count count adjacent pairs in the admitted total order where both observations are valid (an intervening invalid or crossed observation breaks adjacency; equal-time ordered updates are adjacent). All four require continuous sampling (UNSUPPORTED_SAMPLING under trade_snapshot) because adjacency between trade-associated snapshots is not quote-state succession. One valid observation gives insufficient_history (expected 2, observed 1); zero gives no_eligible_observations; pair counts are values (0 allowed). New unit string pairs.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: allow on snapshots; carry across invalid states; consecutive-valid pairs. Reason: change between snapshots is not an update-to-update dynamic.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Per the reviewed EQ-159 clarification: quote.sampled.maximum_spread = max over valid observations of the cash spread; quote.sampled.maximum_midpoint_bps = max over valid observations of that observation's own 20000*(a-b)/(a+b). Never the maximum spread over a separately selected midpoint, never a ratio of means. All admitted valid observations are evaluated whatever the evidence limit; ties select the earliest by (event_ns, order_key, event_id); the retention limit changes neither values, quality nor the primary witness. Sampling mode, entity, source, order, scale and currency, basis, cutoff and original availability are identity; no continuous-time maximum is inferred.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: maximum over retained evidence only; later tie. Reason: the clarification requires truncation invariance and the earliest-tie rule.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Every delivered row is part of the population: a row with known_at null (unknown_availability) or after K (future_knowledge) blocks every output, even a crossed row, because omitting it could change a maximum, a final observation or an adjacency. A known_at equal to K is available. Delivery completeness is the declared IntervalCoverage: incomplete is governed_gap; zero rows with complete coverage is observed empty (counts 0, values no_eligible_observations); zero rows without coverage, or an undelivered role, is absent_input. No staleness limit exists here: a long silence under complete coverage is not an error and is not filled.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: ignore unknown rows; max_age expiry; treat empty as absent. Reason: independent knowledge handling per EF1 and EF3; expiry belongs to the existing time-weighted output.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: The admitted total order is (event_ns, order_key) with event_id as the final tie-break; duplicates and unordered rows are refusals, not repaired. All equal-time rows are observations; last is the final in the order.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: dedupe equal time; last-wins collapse. Reason: QUOTE_FORMULAS counts all equal-time ordered updates.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: series_source is an explicit parameter with three values and no default: trade (eligible trades), bar (BAR windows with actual notional) and prepared_window (a supplied compatible window series). Exactly the role of the declared source may be delivered; sources are never mixed or pooled in one result and the source is part of the result identity.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: default to bars; allow trades plus bars. Reason: a bar series and a trade series have different points and cannot be silently substituted.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: The path is the anchored cumulative VWAP: W_k = cumulative notional over cumulative volume after the first k points, reset at the declared anchor. Per-window (non-cumulative) VWAP slope is deferred to an amendment. Reason: cumulative anchored VWAP is the quantity the accepted EF1 anchored totals define; per-window VWAPs would need a window-weight convention.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: per-window VWAP points; rolling VWAP.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Trade source: eligible price*size (positive integers). Bar and prepared_window: supplied actual_notional over volume. A positive-volume window must supply a positive actual notional; close*volume, typical price or extrema are never substituted (EF1_ANCHORS). Ineligible trades are not operands: their payload and knowledge are never read. An eligible trade needs a non-null positive price and size: the shared validator raises INVALID_SCHEMA otherwise (so null_field is not reachable on the trade source).
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: close*volume proxy; high/low typical price. Reason: EF1 anchors forbids proxies.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: The coordinate is UTC wall-clock nanoseconds: trade event_ns for the trade source and the completed window end_ns for bar sources (a window's content is known only at its end, so the end is the causal coordinate). Slopes are published per second using the exact factor 10^9. The axis is not trade count, not window index and not cumulative volume.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: window midpoint; window start; volume-time axis (deferred). Reason: causal, exact, and the only axis that makes irregular spacing meaningful.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: The anchor is the declared interval start S carried by the ef4.interval.bounds fact; cumulative sums reset there and nothing carries across intervals. The anchor fact needs original known_at <= K (null is unknown_availability, later is future_knowledge) in both known-at and reconstruction modes. Rows before S are BOUNDS refusals; the anchor price is not a path point.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: previous close as anchor; automatic reset; carry. Reason: reset epoch mode only, as EF3.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: x is used as supplied: no resampling, no forward fill, no window-index substitute. Equal x is legal (ordered by order_key); a zero total time span makes endpoint and OLS slopes not_applicable/zero_denominator while level, change and count stay available.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: resample to the grid; refuse equal times. Reason: preparing a regular series is a caller concern.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: A covered zero-volume window (null prices, null or zero notional) is a structurally empty window, not a missing interval: it contributes no point and no weight and is a ready slot. Following EF1_PATHS (zero-volume bar payload and knowledge are not operands) the known_at and notional of a slot whose volume is exactly 0 are not read: V35 pins a zero-volume slot known after K as ready; a slot with null volume is different, its volume is indeterminate and its knowledge is read (V09). A notional of 0 is allowed on zero volume exactly as the shared validator allows zero or absent notional (V36); a nonzero notional on zero volume is the shared INVALID_SCHEMA refusal. All windows empty gives point_count 0 and no_eligible_observations.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: repeat the previous W as a point; treat as gap. Reason: repeating a point would bias the equal-weight regression and invent a price.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: For bar and prepared_window the grid fixes the expected slots. A slot with no row and a declared incomplete coverage is governed_gap; a slot with neither row nor coverage is absent_input. Any unready slot blocks every output, because the anchored cumulative path depends on all earlier points (no finite recovery). Trade-source completeness is the declared batch IntervalCoverage. The grid edge facts are read like the anchor: an edge fact with known_at null or after K gives unknown_availability or future_knowledge on every output with observed 0 (V37, V38). For bar and prepared sources the interval end E must not exceed the market cutoff C (a bar ending after C is already a shared BOUNDS refusal), so future_market is reachable only for the trade and quote sources; E > C with a bar source is the library BOUNDS refusal RV44.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: skip missing windows; interpolate. Reason: no silent compression of the governed grid (R17).
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: series_source prepared_window accepts supplied window rows without recomputing them from trades. Acceptance needs: one ef4.series.proof fact whose text equals the config series_policy_id, a grid equal to the config grid_version with first edge S and last edge E, bars aligned to grid slots, and equal unit and basis. The label is an identity binding by the preparer, not a proof of arithmetic correctness: tests of the preparer own that. Arithmetic is identical to the bar source, so a prepared series and the same windows as bars give identical values (V02 equals V03), and several outputs and configs can share one prepared series (V04).
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: always recompute from trades; accept a label alone. Reason: the issue requires support without forcing a trade-window recomputation; a feature label alone is never compatibility proof (INTRADAY_FOUNDATIONS).
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: A correction is a new batch revision. One batch holds exactly one version per row or slot (a second version is DUPLICATE). The library never chooses between versions: a corrected row known after K is future_knowledge, a corrected row known by K is used. Earlier results stay immutable (V13, V14, V15).
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: library selects latest-known version. Reason: late corrections require a new supplied revision and recalculation (INTRADAY_FOUNDATIONS).
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Two named estimators with equal point weights: endpoint (W_n - W_1)/(x_n - x_1) and ordinary least squares of W on x. Volume-weighted regression and log-VWAP slopes are deferred. Both need at least two points; a degenerate time variance is zero_denominator.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: weighted OLS; Theil-Sen. Reason: minimal exact estimators; no approximate algorithms.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: point_count is an output (0 allowed) and requires only volumes or sizes. No minimum points parameter exists: n = 0 is no_eligible_observations and n = 1 is insufficient_history for outputs needing two points (expected 2, observed 1).
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: min_points parameter. Reason: fewer parameters; two points is the mathematical minimum.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: Maximum and minimum ties select the earliest point in canonical order.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: latest tie. Reason: matches the quote maxima rule.
decisions_proposed.state: author-decided (proposed), pending coordinator and owner review

decisions_proposed.decision: R17 policy as in EF3: exact rational arithmetic and one correctly rounded float64 per published value; per-fixture acceptance rule exact_float64, exact_plus_zero, tolerance, exact_integer; no documented exceptions.
decisions_proposed.alternatives: alternatives: float or Decimal120 intermediates. Reason: parity with the accepted policy.

decisions_proposed.decision: As EF3: absent_input, unknown_availability, future_knowledge, null_field, ineligible, governed_gap, future_market, partial_universe, insufficient_history, no_eligible_observations, empty_universe, zero_denominator; ineligible, partial_universe and empty_universe are unreachable here. Only existing Status and Reason values are used.

decisions_proposed.decision: Batch and full replay only; update, restore and merge are UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY. Cutoff replay is the prefix property (each output at E depends only on rows before E known by K).

layer_responsibilities.library: admission of the supplied facts, interval and anchor handling, observation classification, microprice, maxima, change and path arithmetic, extrema and slopes, quality, evidence and every library refusal; pure and deterministic with exact rational intermediates and one final rounding; one shared interval/knowledge admission for both producers; no coupling of output readiness
layer_responsibilities.io_ef4: maps ordered quote and trade rows, bar windows, grid edges, interval bounds and proof facts exactly as supplied with original known_at and declared coverage; never sorts, fills, imputes, dedupes, converts scale or currency, selects a correction version, derives windows from trades, or computes any statistic; maps results unchanged
layer_responsibilities.worker_ef4: routes selected outputs, shares one admitted interval or prepared series across outputs and configs, keeps independent readiness, executes one config per complete result, binds inputs and the config digest and persists the library result unchanged; direct, adapter, worker and stored results identical including refusal class

non_goals: no thresholds, scanners, alert or signal policy
no default sampling, series source, grid or interval
no time-weighted or continuous-time quote statistic and no change to the existing session.quote.* outputs
no quote seed, expiry or staleness limit
no depth beyond top of book and no venue merging
no trade signing, tick rule or tape statistic (EQ-158, EQ-161 to EQ-163)
no path efficiency, choppiness or notional top-K (other authors)
no per-window or rolling VWAP slope, no volume-time axis, no weighted regression
no recomputation of a prepared series from trades and no audit of the preparer
no acquisition, calendar lookup, price adjustment, currency conversion, imputation or forward fill
no new DataKind, DTO, codec, scheduler, validator or error code
no performance, parity, release or publication claim
no private-source equivalence or source formula
coordinator_freeze: Proposed freeze as ef4-quote1 and ef4-vwap1 (v1) for implementation once this PR merges and the coordinator accepts it (author statement; no review or acceptance claim). Reset epoch mode only. No defaults for sampling, series source, grid or interval. Any change to a convention, label semantics, header, role or fixture after merge requires a new policy label and an amendment document.
hosting: packages/features EF4 module, config namespace ef4.*, separate catalog; describe_intraday() and its digest unchanged; no package version bump
interval_kind_rule: ef4.interval.bounds is the shared declared-interval kind for both EF4-H producers (self-contained definition in reference_fact_schemas); a duplicate (instrument, session, reference_id) is DUPLICATE and two bounds facts with different reference ids are INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY.
header_ledger_to_be_applied: the 16 headers above are to be applied by a sibling amendment document after the freeze; new unit strings pairs and points (OQ-6); bps, currency/share, shares and currency/share/second compound exist or are derived.
amendment_note: Additive producer-set and header-ledger entries needed in the shared contract are recorded here as to-be-applied: two producers, sixteen headers, role schemas and three new reference fact kinds (ef4.interval.bounds, ef4.window.edge, ef4.series.proof). A sibling amendment document follows the freeze. No change to shared validators is required or proposed; the exact split between shared-validator and library checks is in shared_validator_split.
